subject: Digital Signal Processing

questions.markdown:
A) Determine the $Z$-transform of $u[n-2]$ and its Region of Convergence?

B) State and prove the initial value theorem of one sided z-transform.

C) Determine the non-causal signal $x(n)$ having the z-transform

$$
x(z)=\frac{1}{(1-2z^{-1})(1-z^{-1})^2}
$$

A) State the Nyquist sampling theorem. Why is it important?

B) Compute the 6-point DFT of the sequence $x(n)=\{0,1,2,3,2,1\}$.

C) Determine the response of the discrete time LTI system described by the following difference equation for the unit step input. The system has an initial condition $y(-1)=\frac{2}{9}$.

$$
y(n)=-0.8\,y(n-1)+x(n)
$$

A) Use unilateral z-transform to find the response for the system described by the difference equation $y(n)=0.5\,y(n-1)+x(n-1)$ with $x(n)=0.5^n u(n)$ and $y(-1)=1$.

B) Compute 8-point DFT of the sequence $x(n)=\{3,2,1,0,1,2\}$ using decimation-in-frequency FFT algorithm.
List the differences between FIR and IIR filters.

questions.markdown:
A) Realize the following IIR filter using direct form-I and direct form-II.

$$
y(n)=-0.1y(n-1)+0.2y(n-2)+3x(n)+3.6x(n-1)+0.6x(n-2)
$$

C) Determine the impulse response of FIR filter of length 7 to meet the following specifications.

$$
H_d(e^{j\omega})=\begin{cases}e^{-j(M-1)\omega/2} & \text{for } 0\le \omega \le \frac{\pi}{2}\\0 & \text{otherwise}\end{cases}
$$

Use rectangular window.

Bring out the salient features of parametric PSD estimation.

B) Use impulse invariant transformation to convert the analog filter with system function

$$
H(s)=\frac{1}{(s+0.5)(s^2+0.5s+2)}
$$

into a digital filter. Select $T=1$ s.

C) Compute the minimum order and transfer function $H(s)$ of a Chebyshev type-I low pass filter, where the maximum allowable ripple is 1 dB in the pass band extending from 0 to $0.1\pi$ radians/sec. The minimum attenuation should be 40 dB at the stop band edge frequency of $0.3\pi$ radians/sec.
